# C2 pre-freeze source inspection follow-up

This is implementation-stage feedback, not a final arch-review/ai-review verdict, delivery assessment or score. The first formal review and final exact-head verification remain pending. Existing operation failure counter 1 and formal repair-batch counter 0 are preserved.

The coordinator read the current runner, evidence checker, process supervisor, ownership implementation, input selection and offline fixtures. Three related obligations were confirmed against the existing safety and truthful-evidence requirements:

1. C2-PF3: the previous cleanup path could observe a terminated parent without proving its descendants had ended. The implementation now attaches a waiting helper to a Windows job before Cargo starts, keeps a Linux session/subreaper helper, and refuses source-metadata restoration when complete ownership cleanup is unproven. A real parent-exits/child-lives fixture exercises this failure, rather than relying only on mocked Cargo exit codes. The Linux branch still needs its actual CI execution; no local Windows result proves it.
2. C2-PF4: the previous checker accepted an internally consistent reported ranking and an incomplete input hash map without recomputing them from the source commit. The implementation now verifies regular archived Git blobs, checks their identities and complete coverage, compares the frozen lexer, and recomputes the ranking and complete input map from the exact source SHA. New fixtures reject a self-consistent wrong ranking, omitted input hashes, omitted archive entries and unsafe paths.
3. C2-PF5: follow-up inspection found sample acceptance used `sample.get("tree_quiescent") is False`, which rejected false but accepted absent/null proof. Likewise, absent `orphaned_descendants` passed a truthiness check. Require explicit true quiescence and explicit false surviving-descendant evidence. The author confirmed the finding and is updating legitimate fake receipts plus manifest-refreshed malformed/missing proof fixtures. This correction is still in progress.

The previously completed Windows fixture result was 29 tests at staged tree f6bacdd4, retained at private evidence/offline-tests-29-f6bacdd4.log. It is not relabelled as verification of the PF5 correction. No actual Cargo edit-loop timings, calibrated budgets, Linux execution or full synchronized-base verification are claimed yet. No frozen rubric, measurement script or score skill was edited. Source inspection of PF3/PF4 closes the identified code gaps provisionally; final reviewed identity and executed evidence remain due.
